questions.q: What is the capital of Belize?
questions.why: It replaced Belize City after a 1961 hurricane.

questions.q: What was Belize called before 1973?
questions.why: It took the name of its main river.

questions.q: From which country did Belize gain independence in 1981?
questions.why: It is still in the Commonwealth.

questions.q: What is the official language of Belize?
questions.why: It is the only Central American country with English as official language.

questions.q: What is Belize's currency?
questions.why: It is fixed at two to one US dollar.

questions.q: Which ancient people built cities like Caracol and Xunantunich?
questions.why: Caracol was once bigger than Belize City is today.

questions.q: Which neighbour long claimed Belize as its own territory?
questions.why: The dispute went to the world court.

questions.q: Who is called the father of Belizean independence?
questions.why: He was the first Prime Minister.

questions.q: Which 1798 battle saw settlers defeat a Spanish fleet?
questions.why: It is celebrated on 10 September.

questions.q: Which 1961 hurricane led to a new inland capital?
questions.why: It badly damaged Belize City.

questions.q: Which wood brought British loggers to Belize in the 1600s?
questions.why: It was used to make dye.

questions.q: Which Maya site in western Belize has the carved 'El Castillo' pyramid?
questions.why: Its name means 'Stone Woman'.

questions.q: Which Maya site's name means 'submerged crocodile'?
questions.why: It was lived in for over 3,000 years.

questions.q: Which jade head found at Altun Ha is a national treasure?
questions.why: It is the largest carved Maya jade.

questions.q: Who has been Prime Minister of Belize since 2020?
questions.why: He leads the People's United Party.

questions.q: Which famous circular sinkhole is a diving site?
questions.why: Jacques Cousteau made it famous.

questions.q: Which reef off Belize is the second-longest barrier reef in the world?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which large island off Belize is home to San Pedro?
questions.why: It was the setting of Madonna's 'La Isla Bonita'.

questions.q: Which small island's motto is 'Go slow'?
questions.why: Golf carts are the main transport.

questions.q: Which wild cat has the world's first jaguar reserve in Belize?
questions.why: The reserve is in Cockscomb Basin.

questions.q: Which dish of rice and beans cooked in coconut milk is a staple?
questions.why: It is often served with stew chicken.

questions.q: Which people on the coast celebrate Settlement Day on 19 November?
questions.why: It marks their arrival in 1832.

questions.q: Which cave with Maya skeletons is a famous adventure tour?
questions.why: A calcified skeleton is called the 'Crystal Maiden'.

questions.q: Which religious farming community from Europe lives in Belize?
questions.why: Many speak Low German.

questions.q: Which Garifuna musician made 'punta rock' famous?
questions.why: His album 'Wátina' won praise worldwide.

questions.q: What is the national animal of Belize?
questions.why: It is called the 'mountain cow'.

questions.q: Which hot sauce made in Belize is sold worldwide?
questions.why: It uses habanero peppers.

questions.q: Which mountain range in the south holds Belize's highest peak?
questions.why: Doyle's Delight is the highest point.

questions.q: What is the Belize creole language called?
questions.why: It is widely spoken across the country.

questions.q: What is the national bird of Belize?
questions.why: It has a huge rainbow-coloured bill.
